description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for handling article creation within an ASP.NET Core application. It includes data models, validators, a command class, and a request handler that manages creating an article, associating tags, and saving the data to the database.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data model representing the article's properties like title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator ensuring article data fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command object encapsulating article data for creating a new article.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the Command object, ensuring it contains valid article data.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of an article, including associating tags, and persisting data to the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the article creation logic: fetching author, processing tags, creating and saving the article, and returning the result.
